maintenance_led.reason: Sells subscription data collaboration, identity resolution and clean room software for marketing; not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private brands, publishers and platforms like Costco, Netflix, Comcast paying for marketing data software.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own data collaboration platform; acquisitions (e.g., Habu) are occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Identity resolution and clean room embedded in customers' marketing data stacks and partner network; switching means re-integration and lost connectivity.
